page.headline: 6 Sauna Shopping Myths Price-Conscious Buyers Still Hear, and What the Evidence Says
page.dek: Before you spend a five-figure amount of time chasing a number, here's what actually holds up when you shop for a home sauna.

reasons.heading: You have to call to get a real price
reasons.text: Plenty of sites keep pricing off the page and ask for a name and phone number before they'll tell you anything. The Peak Fuji lists its price right on the product page: no form, no call required to see it.

proof.text: The Peak Fuji is priced at $8,250, listed openly on its own product page.

reasons.heading: Red light therapy is an upgrade you pay more for
reasons.text: Some brands sell red light as an add-on tier. On the Peak Fuji it's included standard, not gated behind an extra payment.

proof.text: Medical-grade red light therapy comes included standard on the Peak Fuji.

reasons.heading: A home sauna needs special electrical work
reasons.text: It's reasonable to assume a sauna needs an electrician and a panel upgrade. The Peak Fuji runs on a dedicated 120V/20A outlet, not a specialty circuit most homes would need to add from scratch.

proof.text: The Peak Fuji's electrical requirement is a 120V / 20A outlet.

reasons.heading: Free shipping is a line in an email, not the real cost
reasons.text: A lot of buyers expect a surprise freight charge at checkout. PEAK lists free shipping as a stated policy, with handling and transit timing spelled out in advance.

proof.text: PEAK offers free shipping on all orders, with a two to four business day handling window, then three to seven business days in transit.

reasons.heading: You can't know what you're buying until you talk to a salesperson
reasons.text: As the ad speaker found, some brands require a name and phone number just to see basic information. In the ad, she says she came across Peak saunas and had all the information laid out right there, and that she didn't have to talk to anyone.

proof.text: As one shopper put it, "that's the type of experience we're looking for these days."

reasons.heading: Limited lifetime warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page.
reasons.text: Limited lifetime warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page.

proof.text: Limited lifetime warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page.

for_you.text: You want to see a firm price before you give up contact details.
You have a spot near a 120V/20A outlet to place a two-person cabin.
You want red light therapy included standard, not billed as an add-on.

not_for_you.text: You need a sauna for more than two people at once.
You don't have access to a dedicated 120V/20A outlet.
You'd rather not plan for a disassemble-and-repack return process.

questions.question: Does the Peak Fuji's price ever change based on who's asking?
questions.answer: No. The price shown on the Peak Fuji product page is the price, with nothing to submit first. The Peak Fuji is priced at $8,250.

questions.question: What electrical setup does the Peak Fuji need?
questions.answer: The Peak Fuji runs on a dedicated 120V / 20A outlet. Confirm that outlet is available near your install spot before you buy.

questions.question: Is red light therapy included, or is it extra?
questions.answer: It's included, not an add-on. The Peak Fuji ships with medical-grade red light therapy as standard equipment.

questions.question: Is shipping really free, or is that only for some orders?
questions.answer: PEAK offers free shipping on all orders, with a two to four business day handling window followed by three to seven business days in transit.

questions.question: What's covered under warranty, and for how long?
questions.answer: Limited lifetime warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page. Coverage differs by component, so check that page for specifics before you buy.

questions.question: What's the cabin made from?
questions.answer: The Peak Fuji's cabin material is Canadian red cedar.

questions.question: Can I finance the Peak Fuji instead of paying all at once?
questions.answer: Financing is available through Bread Pay at checkout.

tfzx.failing_item_text: It's easy to rule out a home sauna before checking the actual electrical requirement. The Peak Mini plugs into a standard 120V/15A household outlet, so there's no electrician and no dedicated circuit to arrange first.

failing_texts.$.reasons[2]: A studio membership runs roughly $200 per month, or $2,400 a year. The Peak Mini is priced at $5,450. That means after about 28 months of membership fees, you'll have spent the same amount as the upfront cost of owning one. After that threshold, you're using your own sauna with no ongoing fees, plus the convenience of having it at home.
failing_texts.$.audience_fit.not_for_you[1]: Those without access to a standard 120V household outlet in their intended installation space.

dkvo.failing_proof: In the ad, she says she's really excited it has medical grade red light therapy.
